en.quote: The following metro lines and sections are planned to enter service in 2013–15: … Line 4 (Pravoberezhnaya), from Sennaya Square (Sadovaya station) to Teatralnaya Square (Teatralnaya station).
en.head: Teatralnaya did not open to passengers.
en.body: The original plan called for the section to open by 2015. The city later said the underground station was under construction, but passengers would need a surface entrance. In March 2026, a St Petersburg deputy governor spoke of opening the station by 2030. It did not open to passengers in the promised 2013–15 period.
en.meta_context: Resolution No. 44, concept for metro development to 2020
